docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
The epic of Vasco da Gama's voyage to India and of the Portuguese nation, in the English of the explorer and linguist Richard Burton.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Luís de Camões (about 1524–1580), Os Lusíadas (1572, Portuguese), translated by Richard F. Burton (1821–1890), 1880. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
